meta.task: W-02 — extend the private worksheet to a sell-versus-hold comparison; after-tax module
meta.design_rule: This dataset computes METHOD, not a verdict. It defines exactly which inputs each side needs, which of those inputs are verified, and it refuses to emit a single preferred number while required inputs are missing. The live arithmetic happens in the reader's browser (assets/js/calc.js) on inputs the reader owns; nothing typed there is transmitted or stored.

market_anchors.use: Risk-free anchor. A commercial cap rate is built as this plus a spread; the spreadsheet must not hard-code a cap rate without showing the spread.
A 31 basis point spread (4.84% low on 2026-11-05 to 5.15% high on 2026-11-13) within a single month is a reminder that exit cap rate assumptions move.
Local inflation. Rent escalations below this are real decreases.

market_anchors.metric: All-Transactions HPI, metro, latest vs peak in extracted window
market_anchors.use: The metro index has rolled over slightly. Two quarters is not a trend; it is a reason not to model permanent appreciation.
Basis for the rent-loss stress probability, not for the base case.

sell_side_inputs.why: Drives NOI. Private; lives only in the browser calculator.
NNN recoveries; unverified whether all three nets are truly recovered.
No official source publishes single-tenant QSR cap rates. Must come from actual broker quotes, not a guess.
2030-2035 window is too wide. See G-04.
Private. Required for the after-tax leg.
Drives unrecaptured section 1250 gain at the 25% federal ceiling.

sell_side_inputs.input: Outstanding mortgage balance and prepayment penalty
sell_side_inputs.why: Net proceeds, not gross price, is what funds a replacement asset.

sell_side_inputs.input: Selling costs (commission, title, transfer tax, legal)
sell_side_inputs.why: Typically 3-6% of price; materially changes the after-tax number.

sell_side_inputs.input: Owner filing status and other taxable income
sell_side_inputs.why: Private and decisive: it sets the federal bracket, the NIIT threshold test and the California bracket.

sell_side_inputs.input: State of residence for the year of sale
sell_side_inputs.why: California taxes gains as ordinary income; a different domicile changes the arithmetic entirely.

hold_side_inputs.why: The thing being given up by selling.

hold_side_inputs.input: Probability and rent level of renewal
hold_side_inputs.why: Set as an explicit distribution, never a single number.

hold_side_inputs.input: Downtime months and re-leasing cost if the tenant leaves
hold_side_inputs.why: QSR pads can sit vacant for 12-24 months; this is the main hold-side risk.
Roof, HVAC, parking, seismic retrofit. NNN often leaves structure and roof with the landlord.
Post-2025 fire-market repricing is the biggest single swing factor for a California hold.
Anchored to VA-01 plus a spread.

hold_side_inputs.input: Discount rate for the hold cash flows
hold_side_inputs.why: Must be at least the cost of capital, otherwise holding always wins on paper.

tax_rules.rule: Federal long-term capital gain rate (2026 Rev. Proc. 2025-32 / 2025 Topic 409)

tax_rules.why_it_matters: Depreciation taken over a long hold comes back at 25%, which is often higher than the 20% rate on the rest of the gain. Owners routinely under-reserve for this.

tax_rules.detail: 3.8% on the lesser of net investment income or MAGI above $200k single/HoH, $250k MFJ, $125k MFS
No preferential rate; net capital gain is taxed as ordinary income at California PIT rates
Schedule CA (540) line 7a instructions state California taxes long and short term gains as regular income with no special long-term rate
Business or investment real property qualifies; 45 days to identify, 180 days to complete, or the return due date if earlier
tax_rules.why_it_matters: Deferral is the only structural lever that changes the after-tax comparison without changing the price. It must be evaluated BEFORE the sale, not after.

tax_rules.detail: Adjusted basis is cost less depreciation allowed or allowable; recapture follows from that

tax_rules.rule: California PIT rate schedules (2026 Schedules X, Y, Z)
tax_rules.detail: Verified 1.00% to 12.30% across 9 brackets (+3.4% CCPI indexing). Top 12.30% tier begins over $768,213 Single/MFS, $1,536,426 MFJ, $1,044,771 HoH
tax_rules.why_it_matters: Verified directly from FTB Tax News October 2026 (closing IR-06). Both progressive 2026 brackets and manual marginal rate are now available in the browser calculator.

tax_rules.rule: California Mental Health Services Act (MHSA) surcharge
tax_rules.detail: Additional 1.00% tax on California taxable income over $1,000,000 (making combined top CA marginal rate 13.30%)
1% base property tax + voter debt; max 2% annual assessed-value growth; resets to market value on sale or new construction

decision_options_risk_matrix.wealth_preservation: Eliminates single-asset, tenant-closure, and LA wildfire/seismic tail risk; converts illiquid pad into diversified liquid assets
decision_options_risk_matrix.growth_opportunity: Reinvestment into diversified equities/bonds or lower-risk debt, starting from a smaller after-tax principal base
decision_options_risk_matrix.key_risks: Immediate federal LTCG (up to 20%), 25% §1250 recapture, 3.8% NIIT, and CA ordinary-income tax (up to 13.3%); short-lease cap-rate discount if near 2030
decision_options_risk_matrix.risk_level: Low operational risk / High immediate tax drag

decision_options_risk_matrix.option: Sell now via IRC §1031 like-kind exchange
decision_options_risk_matrix.wealth_preservation: Removes single-tenant/location concentration & California hazard exposure while preserving pre-tax equity (federal + CA tax deferred)
decision_options_risk_matrix.growth_opportunity: Maintains 100% of equity compounding in replacement NNN or multi-tenant assets in lower-hazard / non-CA jurisdictions
decision_options_risk_matrix.key_risks: Strict 45-day ID / 180-day close clock (disqualification triggers full tax); boot risk if debt is reduced; must pre-identify replacement assets before listing
decision_options_risk_matrix.risk_level: Moderate execution risk / High wealth-preservation efficiency

decision_options_risk_matrix.option: Hold & negotiate early renewal / exercise option
decision_options_risk_matrix.wealth_preservation: Preserves Prop 13 low tax base and contractual NNN cash flow if guaranty is strong; avoids immediate capital-gains friction
decision_options_risk_matrix.growth_opportunity: Contractual rent bumps (must benchmark vs 3.7% local CPI) plus extending WALT compresses exit cap rate if sold later
decision_options_risk_matrix.key_risks: Concentrates net worth in one QSR tenant (Jack in the Box system SSS -1.1% to -6.7% in FY26, 2,115 units & pruning); CA insurance repricing; seismic/fire tail

decision_options_risk_matrix.wealth_preservation: Exposes capital to 12-24 months zero rent plus TI/LC/capex and full Prop 13 reassessment on major new construction
decision_options_risk_matrix.growth_opportunity: Highest upside ONLY if parcel ZIMAS zoning / TOC tier unlocks higher-density mixed-use or stronger QSR/retail rent
decision_options_risk_matrix.key_risks: QSR exclusivity/radius restrictions, parking/drive-thru nonconforming rules, construction cost & 7%+ financing spread risk

decision_options_risk_matrix.wealth_preservation: Worst risk-adjusted path: silently absorbs insurance repricing, roof/HVAC backlog, and potential notice-deadline forfeiture
decision_options_risk_matrix.growth_opportunity: None beyond passive lease roll-off; declining WALT erodes sale multiple every year
decision_options_risk_matrix.key_risks: Irreversible loss of renewal option if NC-01/NC-02 missed; misses 2026-11-30 Prop 13 decline-in-value window (NC-07); forced sale risk post-disaster

gates.question: What is the exact lease expiration date and what options exist?
What is contract rent, and are all three nets actually recovered?
What are two to three real broker cap-rate quotes for this asset class and submarket?
What is adjusted basis and accumulated depreciation?
What is the actual insurance premium and renewal date?
Is there a financing prepayment penalty?
Has the building any unremediated seismic or accessibility deficiency?

decision_rule.statement: Do not select a winner until G-04 through G-10 are closed with documents. Of the ten, G-04 alone can change the answer by more than any market forecast in this project.
decision_rule.why_no_winner_today: The sell side is missing 10 of 10 inputs and the hold side 7 of 7. Any 'recommended' verdict produced from that would be fabricated, which the owner explicitly prohibited.
decision_rule.what_can_be_said_now: Three things are already decidable and do not require a winner: (1) the decline-in-value filing on NC-07 is a dated, low-cost, verified action; (2) the renewal-notice calendar must be pinned even if the sell path is chosen, because an option that lapses removes leverage from any sale; (3) §1031 must be considered before signing a sale, because it cannot be elected retroactively.
